programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - BKFC Belt Battle & More
programme.desc: Former NFL defender Greg Hardy in his first bare knuckle battle against New England's Josh Watson, then John Dodson fights Jarod Grant, Austin Trout vs Diego Sanchez, and Lorenzo Hunt stalks Mike 'The Marine' Richman.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Relentless Rumble
programme.desc: Joseph White welcomes the battle-hardened Guilherme Viana back to the ring in a clash of seasoned savagery, while Pat Casey returns to action against the hard-nosed Zeb Vincent in a grinding war of toughness. Then heavyweight bruiser Parker Porter looks to steamroll the upstart Haze Wilson in a main event packed with fight-ending power.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Fight Fanatics Fists Fly
programme.desc: Young phenom Tyler Sammis fights Cody Schieve, followed by David Bosnick and Andrew Angelcor in an epic battle, and wraps up with Brandon Shavers vs Bryce Henry in a banging finale.

programme.desc: Mason Shaw takes on Lee Browne followed by Darren Hendry in a fist fury with Corey Harrison, then Chaz Wasserman dukes it out with Cedric Severac.

programme.desc: Devin Gibson takes on Albert Inclan in Myrtle Beach, and then Andy Nguyen fights Veronika Dmitriyeva. Rounding out this hour with Macedonian Gorjan Slaveski vs Cuba's Yosdenis Cedeno.
